project_type: Spring Boot 4.1.1 REST API — Maven, Java 21, PostgreSQL
build_system: Maven wrapper (mvnw.cmd). Parent: spring-boot-starter-parent 4.1.1. Lombok annotation processing is explicitly configured in maven-compiler-plugin for both compile and test-compile executions — keep it there.
test_framework: JUnit 5 via spring-boot-starter-webmvc-test and spring-boot-starter-data-jpa-test (already in pom.xml). The only test file is CateringApplicationTests.java which does a @SpringBootTest context load — it requires a live DB, so compile-only verification (.\.mvnw.cmd compile) is the safe check without a DB.
verification_instructions: Run `.\mvnw.cmd compile` from c:\Code\catering-booking-system\catering-api. Exit code 0 = success. Full `.\mvnw.cmd test` requires a live PostgreSQL on localhost:5432/catering_db — only run if DB is available. After FEAT-004 (final FEAT), attempt full test run.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell — use semicolon to chain commands (cd path; command), NOT &&. All commands must be run from c:\Code\catering-booking-system\catering-api as cwd.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md present. Follow existing code style: Lombok (@Data/@Builder/@NoArgsConstructor/@AllArgsConstructor), Jakarta Persistence annotations, @CreationTimestamp for createdAt fields, snake_case table/column names via @Table/@Column.
key_patterns: Base package: codewithnathi.Catering. Sub-packages: entity, repository, dto, service, config, exception, controller. Entities use Lombok @Data+@Builder+@NoArgsConstructor+@AllArgsConstructor (except User which uses @Getter+@Setter). User.java implements UserDetails already. All entities use Long id with IDENTITY strategy. BigDecimal columns use @Column(precision=10, scale=2). Timestamps use @CreationTimestamp with @Column(updatable=false). Enums stored as STRING. Repositories extend JpaRepository<Entity, Long>.
directory_structure: catering-api/ — project root with pom.xml and mvnw.cmd. src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/ — source root. entity/ — JPA entities (User, Booking, CateringPackage, Payment, BookingStatus enum, Role enum). repository/ — Spring Data repos (UserRepository, BookingRepository, CateringPackageRepository, PaymentRepository). dto/ — empty, all DTOs to create. service/ — empty, all services to create. config/ — does not exist yet, create it. exception/ — does not exist yet, create it. controller/ — does not exist yet, create it. src/main/resources/application.yaml — main config. src/test/ — single context-load test.
